text:
Which statement is correct?
A
The Earth orbits the Sun once in approximately 24 hours.
B
The Earth orbits the Moon once in approximately 1 week.
C
The Moon orbits the Earth once in approximately 1 month.
D
The Sun orbits the Earth once in approximately 365 days.
